steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Provence.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Provence, you're absolutely, positively sure I can't burn this place down to the ground?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: All these useless branches and weeds are really getting on my nerves.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: This is the tenth time I've heard you complaining this hour, princess.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Besides, I originally planned on just checking out some stuff alone while collecting some samples for Eyjafjalla along the way.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: You offered to join me in this investigation yourself, so nobody's forcing you to stay if you can't handle it.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Right now, the others are having fun at the beach. You should join them instead of going through this mess here with me.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I can't leave you alone, not with your tendencies.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Even though you're a Catastrophe Messenger, only my knowledge can keep you safe in this kind of fire hazard area.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: All the more reason we can't set this entire mountain on fire.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Even though I know this is your specialty... we're on vacation this time. It'd be best to keep a low profile.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Otherwise, Amiya and the Doctor will end up having to clean up the mess again.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Fine, for their sake, I'll try to put up with this a bit longer.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Hey, do you see that black-colored outcropping over there?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Looks like it might be obsidian. Let's go check it out.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Careful now, don't just go running around. And especially, don't set stuff on fire.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Phew... Keeping her in check is more tiring than the investigation itself.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: But something's off... Even if it's summer, this kind of heat... doesn't seem natural.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Big tail.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Hey, Big tail!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hmm? Wait, you mean me?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Did you notice a weird smell earlier?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Now that you mention it...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hmm. Very faint, but it's definitely there.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: The volcano is expelling more gas than I expected, and the test rune Eyjafjalla gave me is reacting.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: By the looks of things, this place is going to go up in flames even without my help.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Something doesn't seem right about this volcano...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: But the most we can do is turn to Eyjafjalla for confirmation.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Over here, we can get some samples from this outcropping.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ha!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: There, that should be enough!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: We can do some preliminary tests on this sample with our equipment before sending it back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Eyjafjalla should be able to turn the test results around right away.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Just based upon how this obsidian feels to the touch... I can't say for sure, but there's something different about it.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Also taking the smell and the temperature around here into consideration...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I can't say for certain, but...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: What are you trying to say? Spit it out already!
Come at me! What are a few slugs going to do?! I'll take you all out right here!
Curses, the hem of my skirt got stuck...
C-can anyone hear me?! Why are there so many Originium slugs here?!
N-no! Stay away from me! Someone help me!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Someone's calling for help! It's coming from the beach!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Let's hurry over there!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Hey, wait for me!
